talk.system: You are Qwen, a virtual human developed by the Qwen Team, Alibaba Group, capable of perceiving auditory and visual inputs, as well as generating text and speech. Answer in full sentences and write numbers in words.

help.RUNNER: Launch flavour of this cell: llama-server or a custom managed command. Legacy configs derive it from CELL_KIND.
help.CELL_KIND: Legacy launch-kind flag; superseded by RUNNER but still written for old readers.
help.COMMAND: Full shell command for a custom cell. $PORT expands to the cell port.
help.ENV: Extra environment for the command: newline- or comma-separated KEY=VALUE pairs.
help.WORKDIR: Working directory the command starts in (cd before exec).
help.HEALTH_PATH: HTTP path probed to decide the cell is up; empty falls back to a TCP port probe.
help.VLLM_MODEL: HF repo id (e.g. nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4) or a local path; vLLM downloads HF repos into its own cache on first start.
help.MAX_MODEL_LEN: vLLM context window (--max-model-len). Empty: the window the model was trained for, which vLLM takes itself — a large one can exhaust VRAM.
help.GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION: Fraction of VRAM vLLM may claim (--gpu-memory-utilization), e.g. 0.90.
help.QUANTIZATION: vLLM quantization backend (--quantization): auto detects; modelopt for NVFP4 checkpoints, awq/gptq for INT4.
help.DTYPE: Activation dtype (--dtype): auto, bfloat16 or float16.
help.TENSOR_PARALLEL: GPUs to shard across (--tensor-parallel-size). 1 on single-GPU hosts.
help.TRUST_REMOTE_CODE: Lets vLLM run the Python code that ships with the model (--trust-remote-code). Some models need it (MiniCPM-o, Nemotron Omni); turn it on only for authors you trust.
help.MAX_NUM_SEQS: How many requests vLLM works on at once (--max-num-seqs). Empty lets vLLM use its own default. A model's recipe may ask for fewer, so that the KV cache fits.
help.KV_CACHE_DTYPE: Data type of the KV cache (--kv-cache-dtype). fp8 takes half the memory of bfloat16; auto or empty follows the model. A value vLLM does not know is refused by vLLM when the cell starts; its list is in vLLM's own help.
help.CPU_OFFLOAD_GB: How many GiB of the weights, per card, stay in RAM and come to the card for every pass (--cpu-offload-gb). The card still computes them, and each pass takes longer for the trips. Empty or 0: all the weights on the card.
help.REASONING_PARSER: Splits a reasoning model's thinking from its answer (--reasoning-parser), for example qwen3 or deepseek_r1. Empty: no flag, and the thinking stays in the answer. The names are vLLM's; a model's recipe names the one it needs.
help.WHISPER_MODEL: faster-whisper model size (tiny…large-v3). Downloaded automatically on first start; language is chosen per request.
help.TRANSLATE_MODEL: NLLB checkpoint: an HF repo id (facebook/nllb-200-distilled-600M, 2.5 GB, downloads itself on first start) or a local directory. Weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0 — non-commercial.
help.TRANSLATE_SRC_LANG: Language of the text coming IN, as FLORES-200 (eng_Latn, rus_Cyrl — language AND script). NLLB is told the source rather than detecting it. Short codes like en or eng are resolved when unambiguous; a language written in several scripts must be spelled out. Per-request override: send `src_lang`.
help.TRANSLATE_TGT_LANG: Language the text comes OUT in, as FLORES-200 (rus_Cyrl, eng_Latn). Per-request override: send `tgt_lang`.
help.SEAMLESS_TGT_LANG: Language SeamlessM4T translates INTO, as ISO 639-3 (rus, eng, deu, fra, spa, zho…). The cell outputs text in this language only — English audio with rus here gives Russian, and no English transcript is produced along the way. Per-request override: send `language` with the audio.
help.STRATA_CONTEXT: Strata's context window in tokens (--max-context). Empty: the window the model was trained for (262144 for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next); past it Strata stretches the window with YaRN. The longer the window, the less VRAM is left for cached experts.
help.STRATA_KV: Strata's KV cache: int8 (default), q4_0 (half the memory, a little less exact) or k8v4 (8-bit keys, 4-bit values).
help.STRATA_DRAFT_VOCAB: Tokens the MTP draft layer guesses: cyrillic (English, code and the Cyrillic script — for Russian answers), cjk (Chinese, Japanese, Korean), en (English and code, the least VRAM) or fr (French).
help.STRATA_VRAM_RESERVE_MIB: VRAM Strata leaves free for other cells, in MiB (--vram-reserve-mib). Empty: none — Strata fills the card with cached experts at its start, and a cell started after it finds no room.
help.STRATA_ENGRAM_FILE: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Strata: the n-gram table every IST-DAS set reads (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-Engram-IQ4_NL.gguf, 111 GB), relative to the models directory. Empty: found in the library when the cell is saved.
help.STRATA_META_FILE: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Strata: the 5.8 MB first part of Unsloth's UD-Q8_K_XL set, read only for the Engram's hash parameters when the pack is made; the other eight parts are not brought. Empty: found in the library when the cell is saved.
help.GR00T_BACKBONE: The folder of the backbone the GR00T checkpoint names in its config.json (nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B for N1.7). The scout brings it like the checkpoint; the cell never asks the hub for it. Empty: Cosmos-Reason2-2B/nvidia/BF16.
help.GR00T_EMBODIMENT: The robot the policy acts for, as an Isaac-GR00T embodiment tag. Empty: OXE_DROID_RELATIVE_EEF_RELATIVE_JOINT, the base checkpoint's DROID arm. The cell answers only that robot's schema; another robot needs fine-tuning first.
help.GR00T_DENOISING_STEPS: Denoising steps of the action head, 1 to 64. Empty: the checkpoint's own (4). More steps take longer per request.
help.PAGE_URL: The https address of the page the cell serves itself, through the reverse proxy in front of the cell: a name of its own (https://personaplex.example.org) whose rule passes WebSocket on to the cell's port. A microphone needs a secure page, and the cell answers plain http in the LAN. The card's 🌐 opens it. Empty: no link.
help.TTS_ENGINE: The engine that takes the voice from a sample: xtts (XTTS-v2 — 17 languages, Russian among them; its weights are non-commercial), cosyvoice (CosyVoice2 — Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean; Apache-2.0) or f5 (F5-TTS — English and Chinese; its weights are non-commercial in practice). It installs itself at the cell's first start.
help.MOONSHINE_MODEL: Moonshine v2 language (en es zh ja ko vi uk ar) — CPU-only STT, the model downloads itself on first start. en is MIT-licensed; the rest need the free Moonshine Community License (registration + attribution). No Russian — use whisper for RU.
help.PORT: llama.cpp HTTP port. OpenAI-compatible API is /v1 on this port.
help.LLAMA_MODELS_DIR: Directory where local GGUF models and mmproj files are stored.
help.MODEL_FILE: GGUF model path relative to the models directory.
help.MMPROJ_FILE: Multimodal projector path. Empty means text-only mode.
help.SPEC_TYPE: Speculative decoding type (--spec-type). Draft-model types (need a draft file): draft-dflash, draft-dspark, draft-eagle3, draft-mtp, draft-simple. Prompt-drafting types (no file, no extra VRAM): ngram-simple, ngram-map-k, ngram-map-k4v, ngram-mod, ngram-cache. Left empty with a draft file set, the type is read from the file: from the first word of its name (mtp, dflash, dspark, eagle3), draft-mtp for a file in an mtp folder, else draft-simple. Empty/none disables it.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_MODEL_FILE: Draft / MTP-head GGUF path (--model-draft), relative to the models directory. Required to enable speculative decoding.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_GPU_LAYERS: GPU layers for the draft model (--gpu-layers-draft). 999/all keeps the small drafter on GPU.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_MAX: Maximum draft tokens per speculative step (--spec-draft-n-max, default 3). A DFlash sidecar denoises a whole block in one pass, so setting this to its block size (16 for Muse Glimmer) is worth roughly 3x throughput; values above the block size are ignored.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_MIN: Minimum draft tokens before speculative decoding is used (--spec-draft-n-min).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_P_MIN: Minimum draft probability before a token is proposed (--spec-draft-p-min, default 0.00). Raising it trades draft depth for acceptance rate.
help.LOAD_MODE: How the model is loaded (--load-mode): none, mmap, mlock, mmap+mlock or dio. Supersedes the deprecated MMAP and ENABLE_MLOCK toggles — when set, those two are not emitted.
help.N_CPU_MOE: Keep the MoE expert weights of the first N layers in CPU RAM (--n-cpu-moe). The knob that decides whether a large MoE model fits the card at all.
help.MTMD_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS: Maximum image tokens per batch while encoding (--mtmd-batch-max-tokens, default 1024). Governs the transient VRAM spike of a vision cell.
help.CTX_CHECKPOINTS: Context checkpoints kept per slot (--ctx-checkpoints, default 32). PARALLEL multiplies this, and the board memory estimate does not count it.
help.LOG_VERBOSITY: Log verbosity threshold (--log-verbosity). Raise it to debug a crashing cell without hand-editing EXTRA_ARGS.
help.CORS_ORIGINS: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins (--cors-origins, default *). The proxy does not terminate CORS, so a cell's policy is what a browser actually meets through the proxy.
help.CORS_CREDENTIALS: Allow credentialed cross-origin requests (--cors-credentials). Enabled together with the default origin * echoes any Origin back and always allows credentials — set CORS_ORIGINS before turning this on.
help.TOOLS_RUNTIME: Run the built-in tools in a separate runtime (--tools-runtime): docker:IMAGE, podman:IMAGE, docker-container:ID, podman-container:ID or ssh:TARGET. Without it the tools, exec_shell_command included, run as the server process with no path restriction.
help.API_KEY_FILE: Path to a file of API keys, one per line (--api-key-file). Keeps keys out of the process command line, where API_KEY is visible to any local user via ps.
help.SWA_FULL: Allocate the full-size sliding-window KV cache (--swa-full, default off). The windowed default saves VRAM but changes prompt-cache reuse on SWA models such as Gemma 4.
help.ENABLE_RERANK: Enable the reranking endpoint (--rerank). Wants POOLING=rank — a wrong pooling starts fine and returns nonsense.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_K: KV cache data type for draft model K cache (--cache-type-k-draft).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_V: KV cache data type for draft model V cache (--cache-type-v-draft).
help.CTX_SIZE: Context window in tokens (--ctx-size). Empty: the window the model was trained for, read from its file. Larger values consume more KV cache memory.
help.THREADS: CPU threads used for generation-side CPU work.
help.THREADS_BATCH: CPU threads used during prompt/batch processing.
help.BATCH_SIZE: Logical prompt batch size. Higher can improve prompt throughput.
help.UBATCH_SIZE: Physical batch chunk size. Higher can use more VRAM.
help.PARALLEL: Number of parallel slots. Higher shares context memory across users.
help.N_GPU_LAYERS: How many layers go on the GPU (--n-gpu-layers). "auto" fits as many as the card holds and leaves the rest in RAM — that is what lets a model larger than VRAM run at all, slowly. "all" forces every layer onto the card; an exact number pins the split by hand. 0 = CPU only.
help.CACHE_TYPE_K: KV cache quantization for K. q8_0 saves memory with good quality.
help.CACHE_TYPE_V: KV cache quantization for V. q8_0 saves memory with good quality.
help.KEEP: Tokens to keep from the initial prompt when context shifts. -1 keeps all.
help.CPU_RANGE: CPU affinity range, for example 0-7. Empty lets the OS schedule freely.
help.CPU_STRICT: Use strict CPU placement with CPU_RANGE.
help.POLL: Polling level while waiting for work, 0-100.
help.ROPE_SCALING: RoPE scaling method: none, linear, or yarn. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_SCALE: RoPE context scaling factor. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_FREQ_BASE: RoPE base frequency override. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_FREQ_SCALE: RoPE frequency scale override. Empty uses model/default.
help.KV_OFFLOAD: Offload KV cache to GPU when possible.
help.CONTEXT_SHIFT: Slide the context window on endless generation instead of stopping at the ctx limit (--context-shift). Empty = llama.cpp default (off); 1 = on, 0 = explicitly off.
help.KV_UNIFIED: Use a single unified KV-cache buffer across slots (--kv-unified) instead of per-slot buffers. Empty = llama.cpp default; can change VRAM use with --parallel.
help.MMPROJ_AUTO: Auto-load the multimodal projector companion when present (--mmproj-auto). Empty = llama.cpp default (on); 0 forces off even if an mmproj file is set.
help.MMAP: Memory-map model files. Usually faster startup and lower RAM pressure.
help.NUMA: NUMA mode: distribute, isolate, or numactl. Empty disables.
help.DEVICE: Comma-separated devices for offload. Empty lets llama.cpp choose.
help.SPLIT_MODE: Multi-GPU split mode: none, layer, row or tensor.
help.TENSOR_SPLIT: Comma-separated proportions for splitting tensors across GPUs.
help.MAIN_GPU: Main GPU index for split-mode none/row.
help.FIT: Let llama.cpp adjust unset options to fit device memory.
help.MODEL_NAME: The name clients and pools call this model by at the machine's entry (its scout). Empty: the alias, else the model file's name. Applies at the cell's next start.
help.API_PREFIX: URL prefix for the server, without trailing slash.
help.CACHE_REUSE: Minimum chunk size for KV cache reuse.
help.CACHE_RAM: Prompt-cache RAM cap in MiB (--cache-ram). llama.cpp default 8192; -1 = unlimited, 0 = disable. Lower it on RAM-tight hosts.
help.CACHE_IDLE_SLOTS: Keep the prompt cache for idle slots (--cache-idle-slots) so a returning client skips re-processing its prompt. Empty = llama.cpp default; 0 disables to reclaim RAM.
help.SLEEP_IDLE_SECONDS: Put the server to sleep after N idle seconds (--sleep-idle-seconds), freeing VRAM until the next request wakes it. Empty/0 = never sleep. Trades first-token latency after idle for VRAM.
help.API_KEY: Require this key on every request (--api-key). Usually left empty here — the caravan proxy handles auth; set only for a cell exposed directly.
help.SSL_CERT_FILE: Path to a TLS certificate (--ssl-cert-file) to serve HTTPS directly. Host-local path; usually unset (the proxy terminates TLS).
help.SSL_KEY_FILE: Path to the TLS private key (--ssl-key-file), paired with the certificate. Host-local path.
help.ENABLE_PROPS: Enable POST /props for changing global server properties.
help.IMAGE_MIN_TOKENS: Minimum image tokens for dynamic-resolution vision models.
help.IMAGE_MAX_TOKENS: Maximum image tokens for dynamic-resolution vision models.
help.REASONING: Reasoning mode: on, off, or auto.
help.TEMPERATURE: Default sampling temperature (--temp). Applies to requests that do not send one of their own; llama.cpp's own default is 0.80. 0 = always the most likely token, which is what models tuned for tool calling and phone-style answers are usually measured at. A caller can still override it per request.
help.TOP_K: Default top-k (--top-k): consider only the K most likely tokens. 0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 40. Ignored when the request sends its own.
help.TOP_P: Default top-p / nucleus (--top-p): consider the most likely tokens up to this cumulative probability. 1.0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 0.95.
help.MIN_P: Default min-p (--min-p): drop tokens less likely than this fraction of the best one. 0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 0.05.
help.REASONING_FORMAT: Reasoning output format: none, deepseek, deepseek-legacy, or auto.
help.REASONING_BUDGET: Thinking token budget. -1 unrestricted, 0 disables thinking budget.
help.REASONING_PRESERVE: Keep the reasoning trace across the whole chat history, not only the last turn (--reasoning-preserve). Empty = template default; needs a template with supports_preserve_reasoning (Qwen3.6 suggests enabling).
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE: Built-in chat template name override. Empty uses model metadata.
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE_FILE: Path to a custom Jinja chat template file. Overrides model metadata/template behavior when set.
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS: JSON object passed into the Jinja chat template parser, for model-specific tool/template knobs.
help.ENABLE_THINKING: 🧠 Model reasoning/thinking. On = model default. Turn OFF to force a direct answer (sets chat-template enable_thinking=false) — fixes reasoning models (gemma-4, Qwen3) that otherwise return empty content, e.g. for translation.
help.SKIP_CHAT_PARSING: Force llama.cpp to return raw assistant content instead of parsing reasoning/tool calls.
help.ENABLE_JINJA: Enable model chat templates and tool-capable formatting.
help.ENABLE_FLASH_ATTN: Enable flash attention for speed and lower memory pressure.
help.ENABLE_MLOCK: Ask the OS to keep model memory resident.
help.ENABLE_CONT_BATCHING: Allow continuous batching for queued requests.
help.ENABLE_WEBUI: Enable llama.cpp built-in Web UI. Usually off here.
help.OFFLOAD_MMPROJ: Try to offload vision projector to GPU. Needs extra VRAM.
help.ENABLE_TOOLS: Enable ALL built-in WebUI tools (--tools all): read_file, write_file, exec_shell_command, grep_search, file_glob_search, edit_file, apply_diff, get_datetime. For a specific subset instead, leave this off and use EXTRA_ARGS '--tools name1,name2'. Security risk: tools run as the server process with no path restriction.
help.ENABLE_AGENT: Agent mode (--agent): enable CORS proxy and ALL built-in tools at once. Convenience switch; supersedes TOOLS. Do not enable in untrusted environments.
help.ENABLE_MCP_PROXY: Enable the MCP CORS proxy (--ui-mcp-proxy) so the WebUI can reach MCP servers/tools. Experimental; do not enable in untrusted environments.
help.ENABLE_EMBEDDINGS: Run this server in embedding mode (--embeddings): exposes /v1/embeddings and returns vectors instead of chat. A chat model cannot also serve embeddings on the same instance — use a dedicated embedding model.
help.POOLING: How token states are pooled into one vector (--pooling): none | mean | cls | last | rank. Must match the model: Qwen3-Embedding = last, BERT/bge = cls, e5/gte/nomic = mean. Wrong pooling = garbage vectors.
help.EMBD_NORMALIZE: Embedding normalization (--embd-normalize): -1 none, 0 max-abs-int16, 1 taxicab, 2 euclidean/L2 (default), >2 p-norm. Leave blank for the llama.cpp default (L2).
help.CHECKPOINT_MIN_STEP: Minimum spacing between context checkpoints, in tokens (--checkpoint-min-step, default 8192, 0 = no minimum). With CTX_CHECKPOINTS it decides how much of a long prompt can be rewound instead of reprocessed, and how much memory the checkpoints cost.
help.SLOT_PROMPT_SIMILARITY: How much of a request's prompt must match a slot's for that slot to be reused (--slot-prompt-similarity, default 0.10, 0.0 = disabled). Raising it stops a near-miss from evicting a warm cache; lowering it reuses more eagerly.
help.SLOT_SAVE_PATH: Directory the slot KV cache is saved to and restored from (--slot-save-path, default disabled). Required by the /slots save and restore endpoints; the path is on the cell's own host.
help.SSE_PING_INTERVAL: Seconds between SSE keep-alive pings while a response streams (--sse-ping-interval, default 30, -1 = disabled). A long wait for the first token looks like a dead connection to any proxy that sees no bytes.
help.PRIO: Process and thread priority (--prio): -1 low, 0 normal, 1 medium, 2 high, 3 realtime (default 0). Above 0 on a shared host this cell starves whatever else runs there.
help.CPU_MOE: Keep ALL Mixture-of-Experts weights in CPU RAM (--cpu-moe). The all-or-nothing form of N_CPU_MOE — set one or the other, not both.
help.OP_OFFLOAD: Offload host tensor operations to the device (--op-offload, default on). Turning it off keeps those operations on the CPU, which is the workaround for a backend that computes them wrong.
help.REPACK: Repack weights for the CPU backend while loading (--repack, default on). Off loads faster and runs CPU inference slower.
help.WARMUP: Run one empty pass at startup to warm the caches (--warmup, default on). Off makes the cell ready sooner and the first real request pays for it.
help.CHECK_TENSORS: Validate the model's tensor data at load (--check-tensors, default off). A slower start that names a corrupt download instead of crashing on it later.
help.YARN_ORIG_CTX: The model's original training context for YaRN (--yarn-orig-ctx, default 0 = read from the model). Only for overriding by hand: a CTX_SIZE above the native window already fills this in for a local model.
help.YARN_EXT_FACTOR: YaRN extrapolation mix factor (--yarn-ext-factor, default -1 = the model's own, 0.0 = full interpolation).
help.YARN_ATTN_FACTOR: YaRN attention-magnitude scale (--yarn-attn-factor, default -1 = the model's own).
help.YARN_BETA_FAST: YaRN low correction dimension, beta (--yarn-beta-fast, default -1 = the model's own).
help.YARN_BETA_SLOW: YaRN high correction dimension, alpha (--yarn-beta-slow, default -1 = the model's own).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_P_SPLIT: Probability at which a speculative draft branch is split (--spec-draft-p-split, default 0.10).
help.CPU_MOE_DRAFT: Keep all Mixture-of-Experts weights of the DRAFT model in CPU RAM (--spec-draft-cpu-moe). Frees VRAM for the main model when the drafter is itself a MoE.
help.CORS_METHODS: Comma-separated HTTP methods allowed cross-origin (--cors-methods, default GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS).
help.CORS_HEADERS: Comma-separated request headers allowed cross-origin (--cors-headers, default *). Narrow it and a browser app sending Authorization through the proxy has to be listed here.
help.EXTRA_ARGS: Raw extra llama-server flags appended verbatim to the command, space-separated (e.g. --some-new-flag value). Escape hatch for options without a dedicated field.

talk.system: You are Qwen, a virtual human developed by the Qwen Team, Alibaba Group, capable of perceiving auditory and visual inputs, as well as generating text and speech. Answer in full sentences and write numbers in words.

help.RUNNER: Launch flavour of this cell: llama-server or a custom managed command. Legacy configs derive it from CELL_KIND.
help.CELL_KIND: Legacy launch-kind flag; superseded by RUNNER but still written for old readers.
help.COMMAND: Full shell command for a custom cell. $PORT expands to the cell port.
help.ENV: Extra environment for the command: newline- or comma-separated KEY=VALUE pairs.
help.WORKDIR: Working directory the command starts in (cd before exec).
help.HEALTH_PATH: HTTP path probed to decide the cell is up; empty falls back to a TCP port probe.
help.VLLM_MODEL: HF repo id (e.g. nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4) or a local path; vLLM downloads HF repos into its own cache on first start.
help.MAX_MODEL_LEN: vLLM context window (--max-model-len). Empty: the window the model was trained for, which vLLM takes itself — a large one can exhaust VRAM.
help.GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION: Fraction of VRAM vLLM may claim (--gpu-memory-utilization), e.g. 0.90.
help.QUANTIZATION: vLLM quantization backend (--quantization): auto detects; modelopt for NVFP4 checkpoints, awq/gptq for INT4.
help.DTYPE: Activation dtype (--dtype): auto, bfloat16 or float16.
help.TENSOR_PARALLEL: GPUs to shard across (--tensor-parallel-size). 1 on single-GPU hosts.
help.TRUST_REMOTE_CODE: Lets vLLM run the Python code that ships with the model (--trust-remote-code). Some models need it (MiniCPM-o, Nemotron Omni); turn it on only for authors you trust.
help.MAX_NUM_SEQS: How many requests vLLM works on at once (--max-num-seqs). Empty lets vLLM use its own default. A model's recipe may ask for fewer, so that the KV cache fits.
help.KV_CACHE_DTYPE: Data type of the KV cache (--kv-cache-dtype). fp8 takes half the memory of bfloat16; auto or empty follows the model. A value vLLM does not know is refused by vLLM when the cell starts; its list is in vLLM's own help.
help.CPU_OFFLOAD_GB: How many GiB of the weights, per card, stay in RAM and come to the card for every pass (--cpu-offload-gb). The card still computes them, and each pass takes longer for the trips. Empty or 0: all the weights on the card.
help.REASONING_PARSER: Splits a reasoning model's thinking from its answer (--reasoning-parser), for example qwen3 or deepseek_r1. Empty: no flag, and the thinking stays in the answer. The names are vLLM's; a model's recipe names the one it needs.
help.WHISPER_MODEL: faster-whisper model size (tiny…large-v3). Downloaded automatically on first start; language is chosen per request.
help.TRANSLATE_MODEL: NLLB checkpoint: an HF repo id (facebook/nllb-200-distilled-600M, 2.5 GB, downloads itself on first start) or a local directory. Weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0 — non-commercial.
help.TRANSLATE_SRC_LANG: Language of the text coming IN, as FLORES-200 (eng_Latn, rus_Cyrl — language AND script). NLLB is told the source rather than detecting it. Short codes like en or eng are resolved when unambiguous; a language written in several scripts must be spelled out. Per-request override: send `src_lang`.
help.TRANSLATE_TGT_LANG: Language the text comes OUT in, as FLORES-200 (rus_Cyrl, eng_Latn). Per-request override: send `tgt_lang`.
help.SEAMLESS_TGT_LANG: Language SeamlessM4T translates INTO, as ISO 639-3 (rus, eng, deu, fra, spa, zho…). The cell outputs text in this language only — English audio with rus here gives Russian, and no English transcript is produced along the way. Per-request override: send `language` with the audio.
help.STRATA_CONTEXT: Strata's context window in tokens (--max-context). Empty: the window the model was trained for (262144 for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next); past it Strata stretches the window with YaRN. The longer the window, the less VRAM is left for cached experts.
help.STRATA_KV: Strata's KV cache: int8 (default), q4_0 (half the memory, a little less exact) or k8v4 (8-bit keys, 4-bit values).
help.STRATA_DRAFT_VOCAB: Tokens the MTP draft layer guesses: cyrillic (English, code and the Cyrillic script — for Russian answers), cjk (Chinese, Japanese, Korean), en (English and code, the least VRAM) or fr (French).
help.STRATA_VRAM_RESERVE_MIB: VRAM Strata leaves free for other cells, in MiB (--vram-reserve-mib). Empty: none — Strata fills the card with cached experts at its start, and a cell started after it finds no room.
help.STRATA_ENGRAM_FILE: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Strata: the n-gram table every IST-DAS set reads (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-Engram-IQ4_NL.gguf, 111 GB), relative to the models directory. Empty: found in the library when the cell is saved.
help.STRATA_META_FILE: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Strata: the 5.8 MB first part of Unsloth's UD-Q8_K_XL set, read only for the Engram's hash parameters when the pack is made; the other eight parts are not brought. Empty: found in the library when the cell is saved.
help.GR00T_BACKBONE: The folder of the backbone the GR00T checkpoint names in its config.json (nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B for N1.7). The scout brings it like the checkpoint; the cell never asks the hub for it. Empty: Cosmos-Reason2-2B/nvidia/BF16.
help.GR00T_EMBODIMENT: The robot the policy acts for, as an Isaac-GR00T embodiment tag. Empty: OXE_DROID_RELATIVE_EEF_RELATIVE_JOINT, the base checkpoint's DROID arm. The cell answers only that robot's schema; another robot needs fine-tuning first.
help.GR00T_DENOISING_STEPS: Denoising steps of the action head, 1 to 64. Empty: the checkpoint's own (4). More steps take longer per request.
help.PAGE_URL: The https address of the page the cell serves itself, through the reverse proxy in front of the cell: a name of its own (https://personaplex.example.org) whose rule passes WebSocket on to the cell's port. A microphone needs a secure page, and the cell answers plain http in the LAN. The card's 🌐 opens it. Empty: no link.
help.TTS_ENGINE: The engine that takes the voice from a sample: xtts (XTTS-v2 — 17 languages, Russian among them; its weights are non-commercial), cosyvoice (CosyVoice2 — Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean; Apache-2.0) or f5 (F5-TTS — English and Chinese; its weights are non-commercial in practice). It installs itself at the cell's first start.
help.MOONSHINE_MODEL: Moonshine v2 language (en es zh ja ko vi uk ar) — CPU-only STT, the model downloads itself on first start. en is MIT-licensed; the rest need the free Moonshine Community License (registration + attribution). No Russian — use whisper for RU.
help.PORT: llama.cpp HTTP port. OpenAI-compatible API is /v1 on this port.
help.LLAMA_MODELS_DIR: Directory where local GGUF models and mmproj files are stored.
help.MODEL_FILE: GGUF model path relative to the models directory.
help.MMPROJ_FILE: Multimodal projector path. Empty means text-only mode.
help.SPEC_TYPE: Speculative decoding type (--spec-type). Draft-model types (need a draft file): draft-dflash, draft-dspark, draft-eagle3, draft-mtp, draft-simple. Prompt-drafting types (no file, no extra VRAM): ngram-simple, ngram-map-k, ngram-map-k4v, ngram-mod, ngram-cache. Left empty with a draft file set, the type is read from the file: from the first word of its name (mtp, dflash, dspark, eagle3), draft-mtp for a file in an mtp folder, else draft-simple. Empty/none disables it.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_MODEL_FILE: Draft / MTP-head GGUF path (--model-draft), relative to the models directory. Required to enable speculative decoding.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_GPU_LAYERS: GPU layers for the draft model (--gpu-layers-draft). 999/all keeps the small drafter on GPU.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_MAX: Maximum draft tokens per speculative step (--spec-draft-n-max, default 3). A DFlash sidecar denoises a whole block in one pass, so setting this to its block size (16 for Muse Glimmer) is worth roughly 3x throughput; values above the block size are ignored.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_MIN: Minimum draft tokens before speculative decoding is used (--spec-draft-n-min).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_P_MIN: Minimum draft probability before a token is proposed (--spec-draft-p-min, default 0.00). Raising it trades draft depth for acceptance rate.
help.LOAD_MODE: How the model is loaded (--load-mode): none, mmap, mlock, mmap+mlock or dio. Supersedes the deprecated MMAP and ENABLE_MLOCK toggles — when set, those two are not emitted.
help.N_CPU_MOE: Keep the MoE expert weights of the first N layers in CPU RAM (--n-cpu-moe). The knob that decides whether a large MoE model fits the card at all.
help.MTMD_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS: Maximum image tokens per batch while encoding (--mtmd-batch-max-tokens, default 1024). Governs the transient VRAM spike of a vision cell.
help.CTX_CHECKPOINTS: Context checkpoints kept per slot (--ctx-checkpoints, default 32). PARALLEL multiplies this, and the board memory estimate does not count it.
help.LOG_VERBOSITY: Log verbosity threshold (--log-verbosity). Raise it to debug a crashing cell without hand-editing EXTRA_ARGS.
help.CORS_ORIGINS: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins (--cors-origins, default *). The proxy does not terminate CORS, so a cell's policy is what a browser actually meets through the proxy.
help.CORS_CREDENTIALS: Allow credentialed cross-origin requests (--cors-credentials). Enabled together with the default origin * echoes any Origin back and always allows credentials — set CORS_ORIGINS before turning this on.
help.TOOLS_RUNTIME: Run the built-in tools in a separate runtime (--tools-runtime): docker:IMAGE, podman:IMAGE, docker-container:ID, podman-container:ID or ssh:TARGET. Without it the tools, exec_shell_command included, run as the server process with no path restriction.
help.API_KEY_FILE: Path to a file of API keys, one per line (--api-key-file). Keeps keys out of the process command line, where API_KEY is visible to any local user via ps.
help.SWA_FULL: Allocate the full-size sliding-window KV cache (--swa-full, default off). The windowed default saves VRAM but changes prompt-cache reuse on SWA models such as Gemma 4.
help.ENABLE_RERANK: Enable the reranking endpoint (--rerank). Wants POOLING=rank — a wrong pooling starts fine and returns nonsense.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_K: KV cache data type for draft model K cache (--cache-type-k-draft).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_V: KV cache data type for draft model V cache (--cache-type-v-draft).
help.CTX_SIZE: Context window in tokens (--ctx-size). Empty: the window the model was trained for, read from its file. Larger values consume more KV cache memory.
help.THREADS: CPU threads used for generation-side CPU work.
help.THREADS_BATCH: CPU threads used during prompt/batch processing.
help.BATCH_SIZE: Logical prompt batch size. Higher can improve prompt throughput.
help.UBATCH_SIZE: Physical batch chunk size. Higher can use more VRAM.
help.PARALLEL: Number of parallel slots. Higher shares context memory across users.
help.N_GPU_LAYERS: How many layers go on the GPU (--n-gpu-layers). "auto" fits as many as the card holds and leaves the rest in RAM — that is what lets a model larger than VRAM run at all, slowly. "all" forces every layer onto the card; an exact number pins the split by hand. 0 = CPU only.
help.CACHE_TYPE_K: KV cache quantization for K. q8_0 saves memory with good quality.
help.CACHE_TYPE_V: KV cache quantization for V. q8_0 saves memory with good quality.
help.KEEP: Tokens to keep from the initial prompt when context shifts. -1 keeps all.
help.CPU_RANGE: CPU affinity range, for example 0-7. Empty lets the OS schedule freely.
help.CPU_STRICT: Use strict CPU placement with CPU_RANGE.
help.POLL: Polling level while waiting for work, 0-100.
help.ROPE_SCALING: RoPE scaling method: none, linear, or yarn. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_SCALE: RoPE context scaling factor. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_FREQ_BASE: RoPE base frequency override. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_FREQ_SCALE: RoPE frequency scale override. Empty uses model/default.
help.KV_OFFLOAD: Offload KV cache to GPU when possible.
help.CONTEXT_SHIFT: Slide the context window on endless generation instead of stopping at the ctx limit (--context-shift). Empty = llama.cpp default (off); 1 = on, 0 = explicitly off.
help.KV_UNIFIED: Use a single unified KV-cache buffer across slots (--kv-unified) instead of per-slot buffers. Empty = llama.cpp default; can change VRAM use with --parallel.
help.MMPROJ_AUTO: Auto-load the multimodal projector companion when present (--mmproj-auto). Empty = llama.cpp default (on); 0 forces off even if an mmproj file is set.
help.MMAP: Memory-map model files. Usually faster startup and lower RAM pressure.
help.NUMA: NUMA mode: distribute, isolate, or numactl. Empty disables.
help.DEVICE: Comma-separated devices for offload. Empty lets llama.cpp choose.
help.SPLIT_MODE: Multi-GPU split mode: none, layer, row or tensor.
help.TENSOR_SPLIT: Comma-separated proportions for splitting tensors across GPUs.
help.MAIN_GPU: Main GPU index for split-mode none/row.
help.FIT: Let llama.cpp adjust unset options to fit device memory.
help.MODEL_NAME: The name clients and pools call this model by at the machine's entry (its scout). Empty: the alias, else the model file's name. Applies at the cell's next start.
help.API_PREFIX: URL prefix for the server, without trailing slash.
help.CACHE_REUSE: Minimum chunk size for KV cache reuse.
help.CACHE_RAM: Prompt-cache RAM cap in MiB (--cache-ram). llama.cpp default 8192; -1 = unlimited, 0 = disable. Lower it on RAM-tight hosts.
help.CACHE_IDLE_SLOTS: Keep the prompt cache for idle slots (--cache-idle-slots) so a returning client skips re-processing its prompt. Empty = llama.cpp default; 0 disables to reclaim RAM.
help.SLEEP_IDLE_SECONDS: Put the server to sleep after N idle seconds (--sleep-idle-seconds), freeing VRAM until the next request wakes it. Empty/0 = never sleep. Trades first-token latency after idle for VRAM.
help.API_KEY: Require this key on every request (--api-key). Usually left empty here — the caravan proxy handles auth; set only for a cell exposed directly.
help.SSL_CERT_FILE: Path to a TLS certificate (--ssl-cert-file) to serve HTTPS directly. Host-local path; usually unset (the proxy terminates TLS).
help.SSL_KEY_FILE: Path to the TLS private key (--ssl-key-file), paired with the certificate. Host-local path.
help.ENABLE_PROPS: Enable POST /props for changing global server properties.
help.IMAGE_MIN_TOKENS: Minimum image tokens for dynamic-resolution vision models.
help.IMAGE_MAX_TOKENS: Maximum image tokens for dynamic-resolution vision models.
help.REASONING: Reasoning mode: on, off, or auto.
help.TEMPERATURE: Default sampling temperature (--temp). Applies to requests that do not send one of their own; llama.cpp's own default is 0.80. 0 = always the most likely token, which is what models tuned for tool calling and phone-style answers are usually measured at. A caller can still override it per request.
help.TOP_K: Default top-k (--top-k): consider only the K most likely tokens. 0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 40. Ignored when the request sends its own.
help.TOP_P: Default top-p / nucleus (--top-p): consider the most likely tokens up to this cumulative probability. 1.0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 0.95.
help.MIN_P: Default min-p (--min-p): drop tokens less likely than this fraction of the best one. 0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 0.05.
help.REASONING_FORMAT: Reasoning output format: none, deepseek, deepseek-legacy, or auto.
help.REASONING_BUDGET: Thinking token budget. -1 unrestricted, 0 disables thinking budget.
help.REASONING_PRESERVE: Keep the reasoning trace across the whole chat history, not only the last turn (--reasoning-preserve). Empty = template default; needs a template with supports_preserve_reasoning (Qwen3.6 suggests enabling).
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE: Built-in chat template name override. Empty uses model metadata.
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE_FILE: Path to a custom Jinja chat template file. Overrides model metadata/template behavior when set.
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS: JSON object passed into the Jinja chat template parser, for model-specific tool/template knobs.
help.ENABLE_THINKING: 🧠 Model reasoning/thinking. On = model default. Turn OFF to force a direct answer (sets chat-template enable_thinking=false) — fixes reasoning models (gemma-4, Qwen3) that otherwise return empty content, e.g. for translation.
help.SKIP_CHAT_PARSING: Force llama.cpp to return raw assistant content instead of parsing reasoning/tool calls.
help.ENABLE_JINJA: Enable model chat templates and tool-capable formatting.
help.ENABLE_FLASH_ATTN: Enable flash attention for speed and lower memory pressure.
help.ENABLE_MLOCK: Ask the OS to keep model memory resident.
help.ENABLE_CONT_BATCHING: Allow continuous batching for queued requests.
help.ENABLE_WEBUI: Enable llama.cpp built-in Web UI. Usually off here.
help.OFFLOAD_MMPROJ: Try to offload vision projector to GPU. Needs extra VRAM.
help.ENABLE_TOOLS: Enable ALL built-in WebUI tools (--tools all): read_file, write_file, exec_shell_command, grep_search, file_glob_search, edit_file, apply_diff, get_datetime. For a specific subset instead, leave this off and use EXTRA_ARGS '--tools name1,name2'. Security risk: tools run as the server process with no path restriction.
help.ENABLE_AGENT: Agent mode (--agent): enable CORS proxy and ALL built-in tools at once. Convenience switch; supersedes TOOLS. Do not enable in untrusted environments.
help.ENABLE_MCP_PROXY: Enable the MCP CORS proxy (--ui-mcp-proxy) so the WebUI can reach MCP servers/tools. Experimental; do not enable in untrusted environments.
help.ENABLE_EMBEDDINGS: Run this server in embedding mode (--embeddings): exposes /v1/embeddings and returns vectors instead of chat. A chat model cannot also serve embeddings on the same instance — use a dedicated embedding model.
help.POOLING: How token states are pooled into one vector (--pooling): none | mean | cls | last | rank. Must match the model: Qwen3-Embedding = last, BERT/bge = cls, e5/gte/nomic = mean. Wrong pooling = garbage vectors.
help.EMBD_NORMALIZE: Embedding normalization (--embd-normalize): -1 none, 0 max-abs-int16, 1 taxicab, 2 euclidean/L2 (default), >2 p-norm. Leave blank for the llama.cpp default (L2).
help.CHECKPOINT_MIN_STEP: Minimum spacing between context checkpoints, in tokens (--checkpoint-min-step, default 8192, 0 = no minimum). With CTX_CHECKPOINTS it decides how much of a long prompt can be rewound instead of reprocessed, and how much memory the checkpoints cost.
help.SLOT_PROMPT_SIMILARITY: How much of a request's prompt must match a slot's for that slot to be reused (--slot-prompt-similarity, default 0.10, 0.0 = disabled). Raising it stops a near-miss from evicting a warm cache; lowering it reuses more eagerly.
help.SLOT_SAVE_PATH: Directory the slot KV cache is saved to and restored from (--slot-save-path, default disabled). Required by the /slots save and restore endpoints; the path is on the cell's own host.
help.SSE_PING_INTERVAL: Seconds between SSE keep-alive pings while a response streams (--sse-ping-interval, default 30, -1 = disabled). A long wait for the first token looks like a dead connection to any proxy that sees no bytes.
help.PRIO: Process and thread priority (--prio): -1 low, 0 normal, 1 medium, 2 high, 3 realtime (default 0). Above 0 on a shared host this cell starves whatever else runs there.
help.CPU_MOE: Keep ALL Mixture-of-Experts weights in CPU RAM (--cpu-moe). The all-or-nothing form of N_CPU_MOE — set one or the other, not both.
help.OP_OFFLOAD: Offload host tensor operations to the device (--op-offload, default on). Turning it off keeps those operations on the CPU, which is the workaround for a backend that computes them wrong.
help.REPACK: Repack weights for the CPU backend while loading (--repack, default on). Off loads faster and runs CPU inference slower.
help.WARMUP: Run one empty pass at startup to warm the caches (--warmup, default on). Off makes the cell ready sooner and the first real request pays for it.
help.CHECK_TENSORS: Validate the model's tensor data at load (--check-tensors, default off). A slower start that names a corrupt download instead of crashing on it later.
help.YARN_ORIG_CTX: The model's original training context for YaRN (--yarn-orig-ctx, default 0 = read from the model). Only for overriding by hand: a CTX_SIZE above the native window already fills this in for a local model.
help.YARN_EXT_FACTOR: YaRN extrapolation mix factor (--yarn-ext-factor, default -1 = the model's own, 0.0 = full interpolation).
help.YARN_ATTN_FACTOR: YaRN attention-magnitude scale (--yarn-attn-factor, default -1 = the model's own).
help.YARN_BETA_FAST: YaRN low correction dimension, beta (--yarn-beta-fast, default -1 = the model's own).
help.YARN_BETA_SLOW: YaRN high correction dimension, alpha (--yarn-beta-slow, default -1 = the model's own).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_P_SPLIT: Probability at which a speculative draft branch is split (--spec-draft-p-split, default 0.10).
help.CPU_MOE_DRAFT: Keep all Mixture-of-Experts weights of the DRAFT model in CPU RAM (--spec-draft-cpu-moe). Frees VRAM for the main model when the drafter is itself a MoE.
help.CORS_METHODS: Comma-separated HTTP methods allowed cross-origin (--cors-methods, default GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS).
help.CORS_HEADERS: Comma-separated request headers allowed cross-origin (--cors-headers, default *). Narrow it and a browser app sending Authorization through the proxy has to be listed here.
help.EXTRA_ARGS: Raw extra llama-server flags appended verbatim to the command, space-separated (e.g. --some-new-flag value). Escape hatch for options without a dedicated field.

help.DTYPE: Activation dtype (--dtype): auto, bfloat16 or float16.
help.TENSOR_PARALLEL: GPUs to shard across (--tensor-parallel-size). 1 on single-GPU hosts.
help.TRUST_REMOTE_CODE: Lets vLLM run the Python code that ships with the model (--trust-remote-code). Some models need it (MiniCPM-o, Nemotron Omni); turn it on only for authors you trust.
help.MAX_NUM_SEQS: How many requests vLLM works on at once (--max-num-seqs). Empty lets vLLM use its own default. A model's recipe may ask for fewer, so that the KV cache fits.
help.KV_CACHE_DTYPE: Data type of the KV cache (--kv-cache-dtype). fp8 takes half the memory of bfloat16; auto or empty follows the model. A value vLLM does not know is refused by vLLM when the cell starts; its list is in vLLM's own help.
help.CPU_OFFLOAD_GB: How many GiB of the weights, per card, stay in RAM and come to the card for every pass (--cpu-offload-gb). The card still computes them, and each pass takes longer for the trips. Empty or 0: all the weights on the card.
help.REASONING_PARSER: Splits a reasoning model's thinking from its answer (--reasoning-parser), for example qwen3 or deepseek_r1. Empty: no flag, and the thinking stays in the answer. The names are vLLM's; a model's recipe names the one it needs.
help.WHISPER_MODEL: faster-whisper model size (tiny…large-v3). Downloaded automatically on first start; language is chosen per request.
help.TRANSLATE_MODEL: NLLB checkpoint: an HF repo id (facebook/nllb-200-distilled-600M, 2.5 GB, downloads itself on first start) or a local directory. Weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0 — non-commercial.
help.TRANSLATE_SRC_LANG: Language of the text coming IN, as FLORES-200 (eng_Latn, rus_Cyrl — language AND script). NLLB is told the source rather than detecting it. Short codes like en or eng are resolved when unambiguous; a language written in several scripts must be spelled out. Per-request override: send `src_lang`.
help.TRANSLATE_TGT_LANG: Language the text comes OUT in, as FLORES-200 (rus_Cyrl, eng_Latn). Per-request override: send `tgt_lang`.
help.SEAMLESS_TGT_LANG: Language SeamlessM4T translates INTO, as ISO 639-3 (rus, eng, deu, fra, spa, zho…). The cell outputs text in this language only — English audio with rus here gives Russian, and no English transcript is produced along the way. Per-request override: send `language` with the audio.
help.STRATA_CONTEXT: Strata's context window in tokens (--max-context). Empty: the window the model was trained for (262144 for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next); past it Strata stretches the window with YaRN. The longer the window, the less VRAM is left for cached experts.
help.STRATA_KV: Strata's KV cache: int8 (default), q4_0 (half the memory, a little less exact) or k8v4 (8-bit keys, 4-bit values).
help.STRATA_DRAFT_VOCAB: Tokens the MTP draft layer guesses: cyrillic (English, code and the Cyrillic script — for Russian answers), cjk (Chinese, Japanese, Korean), en (English and code, the least VRAM) or fr (French).
help.STRATA_VRAM_RESERVE_MIB: VRAM Strata leaves free for other cells, in MiB (--vram-reserve-mib). Empty: none — Strata fills the card with cached experts at its start, and a cell started after it finds no room.
help.STRATA_ENGRAM_FILE: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Strata: the n-gram table every IST-DAS set reads (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-Engram-IQ4_NL.gguf, 111 GB), relative to the models directory. Empty: found in the library when the cell is saved.
help.STRATA_META_FILE: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Strata: the 5.8 MB first part of Unsloth's UD-Q8_K_XL set, read only for the Engram's hash parameters when the pack is made; the other eight parts are not brought. Empty: found in the library when the cell is saved.
help.GR00T_BACKBONE: The folder of the backbone the GR00T checkpoint names in its config.json (nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B for N1.7). The scout brings it like the checkpoint; the cell never asks the hub for it. Empty: Cosmos-Reason2-2B/nvidia/BF16.
help.GR00T_EMBODIMENT: The robot the policy acts for, as an Isaac-GR00T embodiment tag. Empty: OXE_DROID_RELATIVE_EEF_RELATIVE_JOINT, the base checkpoint's DROID arm. The cell answers only that robot's schema; another robot needs fine-tuning first.
help.GR00T_DENOISING_STEPS: Denoising steps of the action head, 1 to 64. Empty: the checkpoint's own (4). More steps take longer per request.
help.PAGE_URL: The https address of the page the cell serves itself, through the reverse proxy in front of the cell: a name of its own (https://personaplex.example.org) whose rule passes WebSocket on to the cell's port. A microphone needs a secure page, and the cell answers plain http in the LAN. The card's 🌐 opens it. Empty: no link.
help.TTS_ENGINE: The engine that takes the voice from a sample: xtts (XTTS-v2 — 17 languages, Russian among them; its weights are non-commercial), cosyvoice (CosyVoice2 — Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean; Apache-2.0) or f5 (F5-TTS — English and Chinese; its weights are non-commercial in practice). It installs itself at the cell's first start.
help.MOONSHINE_MODEL: Moonshine v2 language (en es zh ja ko vi uk ar) — CPU-only STT, the model downloads itself on first start. en is MIT-licensed; the rest need the free Moonshine Community License (registration + attribution). No Russian — use whisper for RU.
help.PORT: llama.cpp HTTP port. OpenAI-compatible API is /v1 on this port.
help.LLAMA_MODELS_DIR: Directory where local GGUF models and mmproj files are stored.
help.MODEL_FILE: GGUF model path relative to the models directory.
help.MMPROJ_FILE: Multimodal projector path. Empty means text-only mode.
help.SPEC_TYPE: Speculative decoding type (--spec-type). Draft-model types (need a draft file): draft-dflash, draft-dspark, draft-eagle3, draft-mtp, draft-simple. Prompt-drafting types (no file, no extra VRAM): ngram-simple, ngram-map-k, ngram-map-k4v, ngram-mod, ngram-cache. Left empty with a draft file set, the type is read from the file: from the first word of its name (mtp, dflash, dspark, eagle3), draft-mtp for a file in an mtp folder, else draft-simple. Empty/none disables it.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_MODEL_FILE: Draft / MTP-head GGUF path (--model-draft), relative to the models directory. Required to enable speculative decoding.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_GPU_LAYERS: GPU layers for the draft model (--gpu-layers-draft). 999/all keeps the small drafter on GPU.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_MAX: Maximum draft tokens per speculative step (--spec-draft-n-max, default 3). A DFlash sidecar denoises a whole block in one pass, so setting this to its block size (16 for Muse Glimmer) is worth roughly 3x throughput; values above the block size are ignored.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_MIN: Minimum draft tokens before speculative decoding is used (--spec-draft-n-min).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_P_MIN: Minimum draft probability before a token is proposed (--spec-draft-p-min, default 0.00). Raising it trades draft depth for acceptance rate.
help.LOAD_MODE: How the model is loaded (--load-mode): none, mmap, mlock, mmap+mlock or dio. Supersedes the deprecated MMAP and ENABLE_MLOCK toggles — when set, those two are not emitted.
help.N_CPU_MOE: Keep the MoE expert weights of the first N layers in CPU RAM (--n-cpu-moe). The knob that decides whether a large MoE model fits the card at all.
help.MTMD_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS: Maximum image tokens per batch while encoding (--mtmd-batch-max-tokens, default 1024). Governs the transient VRAM spike of a vision cell.
help.CTX_CHECKPOINTS: Context checkpoints kept per slot (--ctx-checkpoints, default 32). PARALLEL multiplies this, and the board memory estimate does not count it.
help.LOG_VERBOSITY: Log verbosity threshold (--log-verbosity). Raise it to debug a crashing cell without hand-editing EXTRA_ARGS.
help.CORS_ORIGINS: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins (--cors-origins, default *). The proxy does not terminate CORS, so a cell's policy is what a browser actually meets through the proxy.
help.CORS_CREDENTIALS: Allow credentialed cross-origin requests (--cors-credentials). Enabled together with the default origin * echoes any Origin back and always allows credentials — set CORS_ORIGINS before turning this on.
help.TOOLS_RUNTIME: Run the built-in tools in a separate runtime (--tools-runtime): docker:IMAGE, podman:IMAGE, docker-container:ID, podman-container:ID or ssh:TARGET. Without it the tools, exec_shell_command included, run as the server process with no path restriction.
help.API_KEY_FILE: Path to a file of API keys, one per line (--api-key-file). Keeps keys out of the process command line, where API_KEY is visible to any local user via ps.
help.SWA_FULL: Allocate the full-size sliding-window KV cache (--swa-full, default off). The windowed default saves VRAM but changes prompt-cache reuse on SWA models such as Gemma 4.
help.ENABLE_RERANK: Enable the reranking endpoint (--rerank). Wants POOLING=rank — a wrong pooling starts fine and returns nonsense.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_K: KV cache data type for draft model K cache (--cache-type-k-draft).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_V: KV cache data type for draft model V cache (--cache-type-v-draft).
help.CTX_SIZE: Context window in tokens (--ctx-size). Empty: the window the model was trained for, read from its file. Larger values consume more KV cache memory.
help.THREADS: CPU threads used for generation-side CPU work.
help.THREADS_BATCH: CPU threads used during prompt/batch processing.
help.BATCH_SIZE: Logical prompt batch size. Higher can improve prompt throughput.
help.UBATCH_SIZE: Physical batch chunk size. Higher can use more VRAM.
help.PARALLEL: Number of parallel slots. Higher shares context memory across users.
help.N_GPU_LAYERS: How many layers go on the GPU (--n-gpu-layers). "auto" fits as many as the card holds and leaves the rest in RAM — that is what lets a model larger than VRAM run at all, slowly. "all" forces every layer onto the card; an exact number pins the split by hand. 0 = CPU only.
help.CACHE_TYPE_K: KV cache quantization for K. q8_0 saves memory with good quality.
help.CACHE_TYPE_V: KV cache quantization for V. q8_0 saves memory with good quality.
help.KEEP: Tokens to keep from the initial prompt when context shifts. -1 keeps all.
help.CPU_RANGE: CPU affinity range, for example 0-7. Empty lets the OS schedule freely.
help.CPU_STRICT: Use strict CPU placement with CPU_RANGE.
help.POLL: Polling level while waiting for work, 0-100.
help.ROPE_SCALING: RoPE scaling method: none, linear, or yarn. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_SCALE: RoPE context scaling factor. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_FREQ_BASE: RoPE base frequency override. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_FREQ_SCALE: RoPE frequency scale override. Empty uses model/default.
help.KV_OFFLOAD: Offload KV cache to GPU when possible.
help.CONTEXT_SHIFT: Slide the context window on endless generation instead of stopping at the ctx limit (--context-shift). Empty = llama.cpp default (off); 1 = on, 0 = explicitly off.
help.KV_UNIFIED: Use a single unified KV-cache buffer across slots (--kv-unified) instead of per-slot buffers. Empty = llama.cpp default; can change VRAM use with --parallel.
help.MMPROJ_AUTO: Auto-load the multimodal projector companion when present (--mmproj-auto). Empty = llama.cpp default (on); 0 forces off even if an mmproj file is set.
help.MMAP: Memory-map model files. Usually faster startup and lower RAM pressure.
help.NUMA: NUMA mode: distribute, isolate, or numactl. Empty disables.
help.DEVICE: Comma-separated devices for offload. Empty lets llama.cpp choose.
help.SPLIT_MODE: Multi-GPU split mode: none, layer, row or tensor.
help.TENSOR_SPLIT: Comma-separated proportions for splitting tensors across GPUs.
help.MAIN_GPU: Main GPU index for split-mode none/row.
help.FIT: Let llama.cpp adjust unset options to fit device memory.
help.MODEL_NAME: The name clients and pools call this model by at the machine's entry (its scout). Empty: the alias, else the model file's name. Applies at the cell's next start.
help.API_PREFIX: URL prefix for the server, without trailing slash.
help.CACHE_REUSE: Minimum chunk size for KV cache reuse.
help.CACHE_RAM: Prompt-cache RAM cap in MiB (--cache-ram). llama.cpp default 8192; -1 = unlimited, 0 = disable. Lower it on RAM-tight hosts.
help.CACHE_IDLE_SLOTS: Keep the prompt cache for idle slots (--cache-idle-slots) so a returning client skips re-processing its prompt. Empty = llama.cpp default; 0 disables to reclaim RAM.
help.SLEEP_IDLE_SECONDS: Put the server to sleep after N idle seconds (--sleep-idle-seconds), freeing VRAM until the next request wakes it. Empty/0 = never sleep. Trades first-token latency after idle for VRAM.
help.API_KEY: Require this key on every request (--api-key). Usually left empty here — the caravan proxy handles auth; set only for a cell exposed directly.
help.SSL_CERT_FILE: Path to a TLS certificate (--ssl-cert-file) to serve HTTPS directly. Host-local path; usually unset (the proxy terminates TLS).
help.SSL_KEY_FILE: Path to the TLS private key (--ssl-key-file), paired with the certificate. Host-local path.
help.ENABLE_PROPS: Enable POST /props for changing global server properties.
help.IMAGE_MIN_TOKENS: Minimum image tokens for dynamic-resolution vision models.
help.IMAGE_MAX_TOKENS: Maximum image tokens for dynamic-resolution vision models.
help.REASONING: Reasoning mode: on, off, or auto.
help.TEMPERATURE: Default sampling temperature (--temp). Applies to requests that do not send one of their own; llama.cpp's own default is 0.80. 0 = always the most likely token, which is what models tuned for tool calling and phone-style answers are usually measured at. A caller can still override it per request.
help.TOP_K: Default top-k (--top-k): consider only the K most likely tokens. 0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 40. Ignored when the request sends its own.
help.TOP_P: Default top-p / nucleus (--top-p): consider the most likely tokens up to this cumulative probability. 1.0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 0.95.
help.MIN_P: Default min-p (--min-p): drop tokens less likely than this fraction of the best one. 0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 0.05.
help.REASONING_FORMAT: Reasoning output format: none, deepseek, deepseek-legacy, or auto.
help.REASONING_BUDGET: Thinking token budget. -1 unrestricted, 0 disables thinking budget.
help.REASONING_PRESERVE: Keep the reasoning trace across the whole chat history, not only the last turn (--reasoning-preserve). Empty = template default; needs a template with supports_preserve_reasoning (Qwen3.6 suggests enabling).
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE: Built-in chat template name override. Empty uses model metadata.
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE_FILE: Path to a custom Jinja chat template file. Overrides model metadata/template behavior when set.
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS: JSON object passed into the Jinja chat template parser, for model-specific tool/template knobs.
help.ENABLE_THINKING: 🧠 Model reasoning/thinking. On = model default. Turn OFF to force a direct answer (sets chat-template enable_thinking=false) — fixes reasoning models (gemma-4, Qwen3) that otherwise return empty content, e.g. for translation.
help.SKIP_CHAT_PARSING: Force llama.cpp to return raw assistant content instead of parsing reasoning/tool calls.
help.ENABLE_JINJA: Enable model chat templates and tool-capable formatting.
help.ENABLE_FLASH_ATTN: Enable flash attention for speed and lower memory pressure.
help.ENABLE_MLOCK: Ask the OS to keep model memory resident.
help.ENABLE_CONT_BATCHING: Allow continuous batching for queued requests.
help.ENABLE_WEBUI: Enable llama.cpp built-in Web UI. Usually off here.
help.OFFLOAD_MMPROJ: Try to offload vision projector to GPU. Needs extra VRAM.
help.ENABLE_TOOLS: Enable ALL built-in WebUI tools (--tools all): read_file, write_file, exec_shell_command, grep_search, file_glob_search, edit_file, apply_diff, get_datetime. For a specific subset instead, leave this off and use EXTRA_ARGS '--tools name1,name2'. Security risk: tools run as the server process with no path restriction.
help.ENABLE_AGENT: Agent mode (--agent): enable CORS proxy and ALL built-in tools at once. Convenience switch; supersedes TOOLS. Do not enable in untrusted environments.
help.ENABLE_MCP_PROXY: Enable the MCP CORS proxy (--ui-mcp-proxy) so the WebUI can reach MCP servers/tools. Experimental; do not enable in untrusted environments.
help.ENABLE_EMBEDDINGS: Run this server in embedding mode (--embeddings): exposes /v1/embeddings and returns vectors instead of chat. A chat model cannot also serve embeddings on the same instance — use a dedicated embedding model.
help.POOLING: How token states are pooled into one vector (--pooling): none | mean | cls | last | rank. Must match the model: Qwen3-Embedding = last, BERT/bge = cls, e5/gte/nomic = mean. Wrong pooling = garbage vectors.
help.EMBD_NORMALIZE: Embedding normalization (--embd-normalize): -1 none, 0 max-abs-int16, 1 taxicab, 2 euclidean/L2 (default), >2 p-norm. Leave blank for the llama.cpp default (L2).
help.CHECKPOINT_MIN_STEP: Minimum spacing between context checkpoints, in tokens (--checkpoint-min-step, default 8192, 0 = no minimum). With CTX_CHECKPOINTS it decides how much of a long prompt can be rewound instead of reprocessed, and how much memory the checkpoints cost.
help.SLOT_PROMPT_SIMILARITY: How much of a request's prompt must match a slot's for that slot to be reused (--slot-prompt-similarity, default 0.10, 0.0 = disabled). Raising it stops a near-miss from evicting a warm cache; lowering it reuses more eagerly.
help.SLOT_SAVE_PATH: Directory the slot KV cache is saved to and restored from (--slot-save-path, default disabled). Required by the /slots save and restore endpoints; the path is on the cell's own host.
help.SSE_PING_INTERVAL: Seconds between SSE keep-alive pings while a response streams (--sse-ping-interval, default 30, -1 = disabled). A long wait for the first token looks like a dead connection to any proxy that sees no bytes.
help.PRIO: Process and thread priority (--prio): -1 low, 0 normal, 1 medium, 2 high, 3 realtime (default 0). Above 0 on a shared host this cell starves whatever else runs there.
help.CPU_MOE: Keep ALL Mixture-of-Experts weights in CPU RAM (--cpu-moe). The all-or-nothing form of N_CPU_MOE — set one or the other, not both.
help.OP_OFFLOAD: Offload host tensor operations to the device (--op-offload, default on). Turning it off keeps those operations on the CPU, which is the workaround for a backend that computes them wrong.
help.REPACK: Repack weights for the CPU backend while loading (--repack, default on). Off loads faster and runs CPU inference slower.
help.WARMUP: Run one empty pass at startup to warm the caches (--warmup, default on). Off makes the cell ready sooner and the first real request pays for it.
help.CHECK_TENSORS: Validate the model's tensor data at load (--check-tensors, default off). A slower start that names a corrupt download instead of crashing on it later.
help.YARN_ORIG_CTX: The model's original training context for YaRN (--yarn-orig-ctx, default 0 = read from the model). Only for overriding by hand: a CTX_SIZE above the native window already fills this in for a local model.
help.YARN_EXT_FACTOR: YaRN extrapolation mix factor (--yarn-ext-factor, default -1 = the model's own, 0.0 = full interpolation).
help.YARN_ATTN_FACTOR: YaRN attention-magnitude scale (--yarn-attn-factor, default -1 = the model's own).
help.YARN_BETA_FAST: YaRN low correction dimension, beta (--yarn-beta-fast, default -1 = the model's own).
help.YARN_BETA_SLOW: YaRN high correction dimension, alpha (--yarn-beta-slow, default -1 = the model's own).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_P_SPLIT: Probability at which a speculative draft branch is split (--spec-draft-p-split, default 0.10).
help.CPU_MOE_DRAFT: Keep all Mixture-of-Experts weights of the DRAFT model in CPU RAM (--spec-draft-cpu-moe). Frees VRAM for the main model when the drafter is itself a MoE.
help.CORS_METHODS: Comma-separated HTTP methods allowed cross-origin (--cors-methods, default GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS).
help.CORS_HEADERS: Comma-separated request headers allowed cross-origin (--cors-headers, default *). Narrow it and a browser app sending Authorization through the proxy has to be listed here.
help.EXTRA_ARGS: Raw extra llama-server flags appended verbatim to the command, space-separated (e.g. --some-new-flag value). Escape hatch for options without a dedicated field.

help.GR00T_DENOISING_STEPS: Denoising steps of the action head, 1 to 64. Empty: the checkpoint's own (4). More steps take longer per request.
help.PAGE_URL: The https address of the page the cell serves itself, through the reverse proxy in front of the cell: a name of its own (https://personaplex.example.org) whose rule passes WebSocket on to the cell's port. A microphone needs a secure page, and the cell answers plain http in the LAN. The card's 🌐 opens it. Empty: no link.
help.TTS_ENGINE: The engine that takes the voice from a sample: xtts (XTTS-v2 — 17 languages, Russian among them; its weights are non-commercial), cosyvoice (CosyVoice2 — Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean; Apache-2.0) or f5 (F5-TTS — English and Chinese; its weights are non-commercial in practice). It installs itself at the cell's first start.
help.MOONSHINE_MODEL: Moonshine v2 language (en es zh ja ko vi uk ar) — CPU-only STT, the model downloads itself on first start. en is MIT-licensed; the rest need the free Moonshine Community License (registration + attribution). No Russian — use whisper for RU.
help.PORT: llama.cpp HTTP port. OpenAI-compatible API is /v1 on this port.
help.LLAMA_MODELS_DIR: Directory where local GGUF models and mmproj files are stored.
help.MODEL_FILE: GGUF model path relative to the models directory.
help.MMPROJ_FILE: Multimodal projector path. Empty means text-only mode.
help.SPEC_TYPE: Speculative decoding type (--spec-type). Draft-model types (need a draft file): draft-dflash, draft-dspark, draft-eagle3, draft-mtp, draft-simple. Prompt-drafting types (no file, no extra VRAM): ngram-simple, ngram-map-k, ngram-map-k4v, ngram-mod, ngram-cache. Left empty with a draft file set, the type is read from the file: from the first word of its name (mtp, dflash, dspark, eagle3), draft-mtp for a file in an mtp folder, else draft-simple. Empty/none disables it.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_MODEL_FILE: Draft / MTP-head GGUF path (--model-draft), relative to the models directory. Required to enable speculative decoding.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_GPU_LAYERS: GPU layers for the draft model (--gpu-layers-draft). 999/all keeps the small drafter on GPU.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_MAX: Maximum draft tokens per speculative step (--spec-draft-n-max, default 3). A DFlash sidecar denoises a whole block in one pass, so setting this to its block size (16 for Muse Glimmer) is worth roughly 3x throughput; values above the block size are ignored.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_N_MIN: Minimum draft tokens before speculative decoding is used (--spec-draft-n-min).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_P_MIN: Minimum draft probability before a token is proposed (--spec-draft-p-min, default 0.00). Raising it trades draft depth for acceptance rate.
help.LOAD_MODE: How the model is loaded (--load-mode): none, mmap, mlock, mmap+mlock or dio. Supersedes the deprecated MMAP and ENABLE_MLOCK toggles — when set, those two are not emitted.
help.N_CPU_MOE: Keep the MoE expert weights of the first N layers in CPU RAM (--n-cpu-moe). The knob that decides whether a large MoE model fits the card at all.
help.MTMD_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS: Maximum image tokens per batch while encoding (--mtmd-batch-max-tokens, default 1024). Governs the transient VRAM spike of a vision cell.
help.CTX_CHECKPOINTS: Context checkpoints kept per slot (--ctx-checkpoints, default 32). PARALLEL multiplies this, and the board memory estimate does not count it.
help.LOG_VERBOSITY: Log verbosity threshold (--log-verbosity). Raise it to debug a crashing cell without hand-editing EXTRA_ARGS.
help.CORS_ORIGINS: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins (--cors-origins, default *). The proxy does not terminate CORS, so a cell's policy is what a browser actually meets through the proxy.
help.CORS_CREDENTIALS: Allow credentialed cross-origin requests (--cors-credentials). Enabled together with the default origin * echoes any Origin back and always allows credentials — set CORS_ORIGINS before turning this on.
help.TOOLS_RUNTIME: Run the built-in tools in a separate runtime (--tools-runtime): docker:IMAGE, podman:IMAGE, docker-container:ID, podman-container:ID or ssh:TARGET. Without it the tools, exec_shell_command included, run as the server process with no path restriction.
help.API_KEY_FILE: Path to a file of API keys, one per line (--api-key-file). Keeps keys out of the process command line, where API_KEY is visible to any local user via ps.
help.SWA_FULL: Allocate the full-size sliding-window KV cache (--swa-full, default off). The windowed default saves VRAM but changes prompt-cache reuse on SWA models such as Gemma 4.
help.ENABLE_RERANK: Enable the reranking endpoint (--rerank). Wants POOLING=rank — a wrong pooling starts fine and returns nonsense.
help.SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_K: KV cache data type for draft model K cache (--cache-type-k-draft).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_CACHE_TYPE_V: KV cache data type for draft model V cache (--cache-type-v-draft).
help.CTX_SIZE: Context window in tokens (--ctx-size). Empty: the window the model was trained for, read from its file. Larger values consume more KV cache memory.
help.THREADS: CPU threads used for generation-side CPU work.
help.THREADS_BATCH: CPU threads used during prompt/batch processing.
help.BATCH_SIZE: Logical prompt batch size. Higher can improve prompt throughput.
help.UBATCH_SIZE: Physical batch chunk size. Higher can use more VRAM.
help.PARALLEL: Number of parallel slots. Higher shares context memory across users.
help.N_GPU_LAYERS: How many layers go on the GPU (--n-gpu-layers). "auto" fits as many as the card holds and leaves the rest in RAM — that is what lets a model larger than VRAM run at all, slowly. "all" forces every layer onto the card; an exact number pins the split by hand. 0 = CPU only.
help.CACHE_TYPE_K: KV cache quantization for K. q8_0 saves memory with good quality.
help.CACHE_TYPE_V: KV cache quantization for V. q8_0 saves memory with good quality.
help.KEEP: Tokens to keep from the initial prompt when context shifts. -1 keeps all.
help.CPU_RANGE: CPU affinity range, for example 0-7. Empty lets the OS schedule freely.
help.CPU_STRICT: Use strict CPU placement with CPU_RANGE.
help.POLL: Polling level while waiting for work, 0-100.
help.ROPE_SCALING: RoPE scaling method: none, linear, or yarn. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_SCALE: RoPE context scaling factor. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_FREQ_BASE: RoPE base frequency override. Empty uses model/default.
help.ROPE_FREQ_SCALE: RoPE frequency scale override. Empty uses model/default.
help.KV_OFFLOAD: Offload KV cache to GPU when possible.
help.CONTEXT_SHIFT: Slide the context window on endless generation instead of stopping at the ctx limit (--context-shift). Empty = llama.cpp default (off); 1 = on, 0 = explicitly off.
help.KV_UNIFIED: Use a single unified KV-cache buffer across slots (--kv-unified) instead of per-slot buffers. Empty = llama.cpp default; can change VRAM use with --parallel.
help.MMPROJ_AUTO: Auto-load the multimodal projector companion when present (--mmproj-auto). Empty = llama.cpp default (on); 0 forces off even if an mmproj file is set.
help.MMAP: Memory-map model files. Usually faster startup and lower RAM pressure.
help.NUMA: NUMA mode: distribute, isolate, or numactl. Empty disables.
help.DEVICE: Comma-separated devices for offload. Empty lets llama.cpp choose.
help.SPLIT_MODE: Multi-GPU split mode: none, layer, row or tensor.
help.TENSOR_SPLIT: Comma-separated proportions for splitting tensors across GPUs.
help.MAIN_GPU: Main GPU index for split-mode none/row.
help.FIT: Let llama.cpp adjust unset options to fit device memory.
help.MODEL_NAME: The name clients and pools call this model by at the machine's entry (its scout). Empty: the alias, else the model file's name. Applies at the cell's next start.
help.API_PREFIX: URL prefix for the server, without trailing slash.
help.CACHE_REUSE: Minimum chunk size for KV cache reuse.
help.CACHE_RAM: Prompt-cache RAM cap in MiB (--cache-ram). llama.cpp default 8192; -1 = unlimited, 0 = disable. Lower it on RAM-tight hosts.
help.CACHE_IDLE_SLOTS: Keep the prompt cache for idle slots (--cache-idle-slots) so a returning client skips re-processing its prompt. Empty = llama.cpp default; 0 disables to reclaim RAM.
help.SLEEP_IDLE_SECONDS: Put the server to sleep after N idle seconds (--sleep-idle-seconds), freeing VRAM until the next request wakes it. Empty/0 = never sleep. Trades first-token latency after idle for VRAM.
help.API_KEY: Require this key on every request (--api-key). Usually left empty here — the caravan proxy handles auth; set only for a cell exposed directly.
help.SSL_CERT_FILE: Path to a TLS certificate (--ssl-cert-file) to serve HTTPS directly. Host-local path; usually unset (the proxy terminates TLS).
help.SSL_KEY_FILE: Path to the TLS private key (--ssl-key-file), paired with the certificate. Host-local path.
help.ENABLE_PROPS: Enable POST /props for changing global server properties.
help.IMAGE_MIN_TOKENS: Minimum image tokens for dynamic-resolution vision models.
help.IMAGE_MAX_TOKENS: Maximum image tokens for dynamic-resolution vision models.
help.REASONING: Reasoning mode: on, off, or auto.
help.TEMPERATURE: Default sampling temperature (--temp). Applies to requests that do not send one of their own; llama.cpp's own default is 0.80. 0 = always the most likely token, which is what models tuned for tool calling and phone-style answers are usually measured at. A caller can still override it per request.
help.TOP_K: Default top-k (--top-k): consider only the K most likely tokens. 0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 40. Ignored when the request sends its own.
help.TOP_P: Default top-p / nucleus (--top-p): consider the most likely tokens up to this cumulative probability. 1.0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 0.95.
help.MIN_P: Default min-p (--min-p): drop tokens less likely than this fraction of the best one. 0 disables it. llama.cpp's default is 0.05.
help.REASONING_FORMAT: Reasoning output format: none, deepseek, deepseek-legacy, or auto.
help.REASONING_BUDGET: Thinking token budget. -1 unrestricted, 0 disables thinking budget.
help.REASONING_PRESERVE: Keep the reasoning trace across the whole chat history, not only the last turn (--reasoning-preserve). Empty = template default; needs a template with supports_preserve_reasoning (Qwen3.6 suggests enabling).
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE: Built-in chat template name override. Empty uses model metadata.
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE_FILE: Path to a custom Jinja chat template file. Overrides model metadata/template behavior when set.
help.CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS: JSON object passed into the Jinja chat template parser, for model-specific tool/template knobs.
help.ENABLE_THINKING: 🧠 Model reasoning/thinking. On = model default. Turn OFF to force a direct answer (sets chat-template enable_thinking=false) — fixes reasoning models (gemma-4, Qwen3) that otherwise return empty content, e.g. for translation.
help.SKIP_CHAT_PARSING: Force llama.cpp to return raw assistant content instead of parsing reasoning/tool calls.
help.ENABLE_JINJA: Enable model chat templates and tool-capable formatting.
help.ENABLE_FLASH_ATTN: Enable flash attention for speed and lower memory pressure.
help.ENABLE_MLOCK: Ask the OS to keep model memory resident.
help.ENABLE_CONT_BATCHING: Allow continuous batching for queued requests.
help.ENABLE_WEBUI: Enable llama.cpp built-in Web UI. Usually off here.
help.OFFLOAD_MMPROJ: Try to offload vision projector to GPU. Needs extra VRAM.
help.ENABLE_TOOLS: Enable ALL built-in WebUI tools (--tools all): read_file, write_file, exec_shell_command, grep_search, file_glob_search, edit_file, apply_diff, get_datetime. For a specific subset instead, leave this off and use EXTRA_ARGS '--tools name1,name2'. Security risk: tools run as the server process with no path restriction.
help.ENABLE_AGENT: Agent mode (--agent): enable CORS proxy and ALL built-in tools at once. Convenience switch; supersedes TOOLS. Do not enable in untrusted environments.
help.ENABLE_MCP_PROXY: Enable the MCP CORS proxy (--ui-mcp-proxy) so the WebUI can reach MCP servers/tools. Experimental; do not enable in untrusted environments.
help.ENABLE_EMBEDDINGS: Run this server in embedding mode (--embeddings): exposes /v1/embeddings and returns vectors instead of chat. A chat model cannot also serve embeddings on the same instance — use a dedicated embedding model.
help.POOLING: How token states are pooled into one vector (--pooling): none | mean | cls | last | rank. Must match the model: Qwen3-Embedding = last, BERT/bge = cls, e5/gte/nomic = mean. Wrong pooling = garbage vectors.
help.EMBD_NORMALIZE: Embedding normalization (--embd-normalize): -1 none, 0 max-abs-int16, 1 taxicab, 2 euclidean/L2 (default), >2 p-norm. Leave blank for the llama.cpp default (L2).
help.CHECKPOINT_MIN_STEP: Minimum spacing between context checkpoints, in tokens (--checkpoint-min-step, default 8192, 0 = no minimum). With CTX_CHECKPOINTS it decides how much of a long prompt can be rewound instead of reprocessed, and how much memory the checkpoints cost.
help.SLOT_PROMPT_SIMILARITY: How much of a request's prompt must match a slot's for that slot to be reused (--slot-prompt-similarity, default 0.10, 0.0 = disabled). Raising it stops a near-miss from evicting a warm cache; lowering it reuses more eagerly.
help.SLOT_SAVE_PATH: Directory the slot KV cache is saved to and restored from (--slot-save-path, default disabled). Required by the /slots save and restore endpoints; the path is on the cell's own host.
help.SSE_PING_INTERVAL: Seconds between SSE keep-alive pings while a response streams (--sse-ping-interval, default 30, -1 = disabled). A long wait for the first token looks like a dead connection to any proxy that sees no bytes.
help.PRIO: Process and thread priority (--prio): -1 low, 0 normal, 1 medium, 2 high, 3 realtime (default 0). Above 0 on a shared host this cell starves whatever else runs there.
help.CPU_MOE: Keep ALL Mixture-of-Experts weights in CPU RAM (--cpu-moe). The all-or-nothing form of N_CPU_MOE — set one or the other, not both.
help.OP_OFFLOAD: Offload host tensor operations to the device (--op-offload, default on). Turning it off keeps those operations on the CPU, which is the workaround for a backend that computes them wrong.
help.REPACK: Repack weights for the CPU backend while loading (--repack, default on). Off loads faster and runs CPU inference slower.
help.WARMUP: Run one empty pass at startup to warm the caches (--warmup, default on). Off makes the cell ready sooner and the first real request pays for it.
help.CHECK_TENSORS: Validate the model's tensor data at load (--check-tensors, default off). A slower start that names a corrupt download instead of crashing on it later.
help.YARN_ORIG_CTX: The model's original training context for YaRN (--yarn-orig-ctx, default 0 = read from the model). Only for overriding by hand: a CTX_SIZE above the native window already fills this in for a local model.
help.YARN_EXT_FACTOR: YaRN extrapolation mix factor (--yarn-ext-factor, default -1 = the model's own, 0.0 = full interpolation).
help.YARN_ATTN_FACTOR: YaRN attention-magnitude scale (--yarn-attn-factor, default -1 = the model's own).
help.YARN_BETA_FAST: YaRN low correction dimension, beta (--yarn-beta-fast, default -1 = the model's own).
help.YARN_BETA_SLOW: YaRN high correction dimension, alpha (--yarn-beta-slow, default -1 = the model's own).
help.SPEC_DRAFT_P_SPLIT: Probability at which a speculative draft branch is split (--spec-draft-p-split, default 0.10).
help.CPU_MOE_DRAFT: Keep all Mixture-of-Experts weights of the DRAFT model in CPU RAM (--spec-draft-cpu-moe). Frees VRAM for the main model when the drafter is itself a MoE.
help.CORS_METHODS: Comma-separated HTTP methods allowed cross-origin (--cors-methods, default GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS).
help.CORS_HEADERS: Comma-separated request headers allowed cross-origin (--cors-headers, default *). Narrow it and a browser app sending Authorization through the proxy has to be listed here.
help.EXTRA_ARGS: Raw extra llama-server flags appended verbatim to the command, space-separated (e.g. --some-new-flag value). Escape hatch for options without a dedicated field.
